question: Which work goes to Claude, and which goes elsewhere to save Claude's usage?

Any agent may open a light issue. Never put real case files, keys or personal details in any route. DeepSeek and Kimi API spend is the one exception to the $0 rule: prepaid balance only, topped up by the Owner.
